events.text: The K-28 class was built in 1923-1925 by the Schenectady Locomotive Works.
events.subject: self
events.quote: built in 1923-1925 by the Schenectady Locomotive Works

events.text: The building of the K-28 class ended in 1925.
events.subject: self
events.quote: built in 1923-1925 by the Schenectady Locomotive Works

events.text: The locomotives were reclassified K-28 in 1924.
events.subject: self

events.text: The K-28s operated on the Chili Line until that route was closed.
events.subject: self
events.quote: operated on the Chili Line from Antonito to Santa Fe until that route was closed in 1941

events.text: Seven members of the class were purchased by the US Army for use on the White Pass and Yukon Route.
events.subject: self
events.quote: During World War II , seven members of the class were purchased by the US Army

events.text: All seven were withdrawn from service.
events.subject: self
events.quote: All seven were withdrawn from service in 1944

events.text: The seven were barged to Seattle for scrapping.
events.subject: self

events.text: Numbers 473, 476 and 478 were assigned to the Durango–Silverton tourist trains from the 1950s onwards.
events.subject: self
events.quote: were assigned to the Durango – Silverton tourist trains from the 1950s onwards

events.text: The Durango & Silverton inherited these locomotives when it took over the Silverton Branch in 1981.
events.subject: self
events.quote: inherited these when it took over the Silverton Branch in 1981

events.text: As of February 13, 2018, all three locomotives are operational.
events.subject: self
events.quote: As of February 13 , 2018 , all three locomotives are operational

events.text: As of February 2020, number 473 is undergoing conversion from burning coal to burning oil.
events.subject: part_of_self
events.quote: as of February 2020 , number 473 is currently undergoing conversion from burning coal to burning oil

events.text: As of February 2020, number 478 is awaiting a future overhaul.

events.text: High quality scale models in HOn3 and On3 scales have been produced by several manufacturers since the 1950s.

events.text: The Oahu Railway and Land Company ordered four locomotives of the same design.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The Oahu Railway and Land Company in Hawaii was impressed with the K-28 and ordered four locomotives of the same design

events.text: The four locomotives were delivered in 1925.
